notes: Hard (sum 19). A seven-stage dataset/tokenizer/eval pipeline where the outputs of one stage feed the next: (1) filter_locale.py selects the EN locale subset and exports a fixed column set to /app/locale.jsonl; (2) the pipeline downloads a tiny BERT checkpoint + tokenizer into /app/offline_assets/model (adding the standard model_type/tokenizer shims so AutoTokenizer/AutoModel load with the network disabled); (3) tokenize.py loads that exact offline tokenizer and reports aggregate counts over the locale.jsonl text field; (4) bpe.py trains a BPE tokenizer to a bounded vocabulary (<=400) whose merge order is fully deterministic (max-frequency pair, earliest-first-occurrence tie break) and must equal an independent re-derivation exactly; (5) detect_lang.py flags English documents and the verifier holds the flags to overall and per-language accuracy thresholds on a hidden multi-language set; (6) tasks.yaml registers a multi-choice logprobs task (reads query/title columns, exposes the fixed label set, embeds the mandated prompt template, selects the gold label per document) and the harness reproduces the golden overall/macro/per-label accuracy windows on hidden data; (7) fetch_leaderboard.py reaches the runtime leaderboard source and emits the top model id, compared against an independent parse of the mirror. dependent_stages=3: the offline tokenizer is required by tokenize; locale.jsonl feeds token counts, BPE, and the eval; the harness reads the agent-authored tasks.yaml. adversarial_inputs=3: hidden probes include blank/malformed/no-locale filter rows, an empty tokenizer input and a row with a missing text field, empty and tiny-bound BPE corpora, a mixed-language held set with very short edge texts, and a blocked live leaderboard URL forcing the offline mirror fallback. quantitative_correctness=3: token counts, the exact deterministic BPE merge list, and the accuracy windows must all match independent recomputations, not just exist. Interaction statefulness=1 (task registration that the harness must discover, and the offline asset layout the downstream stages load).
